prefix: Warm animated-series illustration, graphic-novel style, clean ink lines, soft cel shading, warm everyday palette with soft natural light, mature tone suitable for teens and adults, not childish, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot in a small neighbourhood library in the afternoon: Lena, a young woman of 22 with light brown curly hair tied back, an olive-green cardigan and round glasses, sits at a wooden table with a plain, titleless hardcover book open in front of her; Kerem, a young man of 24 in a grey hoodie with a backpack, pulls out the chair opposite her. Tall shelves with completely blank spines, warm window light. Vertical composition. Vertical composition.
